citations.claim: On September 4, 2025, the FTC filed a complaint against Gateway Pet Memorial Services, alleging its use of one-year non-competes violated Section 5 of the FTC Act.
The New York Legislature passed S3100A in June 2023, which would have banned nearly all non-compete agreements.
Texas is one of the few states where judges reform (rather than void) overbroad covenants under Section 15.51(c).
Texas courts first determine whether there is an otherwise enforceable agreement, then whether the covenant is ancillary to or part of that agreement.
